name: Cairo Nile Cruise and Petra Tour
description: If you ever wanted to explore the remaining wonders of history and the majesty of old civilizations, With Cairo Nile Cruise and Petra Tour enjoy the gleaming finds of Giza Pyramids, then with Egypt and Jordan Tours explore the flourishing panoramic view of Karnak Temple, feast your eyes with Montazah Palace, walk through the history at Petra, and more Egypt and Jordan Travel Packages.

itinerary.title: Arrive Cairo
itinerary.description: Once your flight landing at cairo Airport, your dreams will come true, Ibis Egypt Tours representative will be waiting for you, holding a sign with your name, then he will escort you to your hotel in Cairo. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Cairo Day Tour
itinerary.description: Tasty breakfast at your hotel, then Ibis Egypt tours representative will pick you up from your hotel, enjoy your sightseeing tours to Pyramids of Giza and the Egyptian Museum, start your tour by visiting the three Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren and Mykerinus, then move to Panorama area, enjoy fabulous photos for the three Pyramids, next move to the Sphinx, visit the Valley Temple, Enjoy Lunch at local restaurant in Cairo, continue your tour by visiting the Egyptian Museum, it is one of the most famous museums in the world, next round will be to Old Cairo including visits to the various Churches there ( Visit maximum 02 churches ), visit Ben Ezra synagogue, at the end of your tour transfer to Giza train station for departure to Aswan by night Sleeper train. Overnight on Sleeper Train Meals: Dinner

itinerary.title: Nile Cruise / Aswan Day Tour
itinerary.description: Ibis Egypt tours representative will pick you up from Aswan train station, he will escort you to your Nile Cruise, check into your Nile Cruise before lunch, visit the remarkable High Dam which was constructed at 1960, it was built to provide Egypt with electricity and irrigation head towards the Unfinished Obelisk, amuse your eyes while visiting Philae Temple, Belongs to Isis and Hathor goddesses, Lunch will be served on board your Nile Cruise, Dinner. Overnight on board your Nile Cruise

itinerary.title: Kom Ombo Temples Tour
itinerary.description: Breakfast on board, enjoy the scenic sailing to Kom Ombo, and explore the Temple dedicated to the two gods Sobek and Horus. Afterward, continue sailing towards Edfu, where you will have lunch on board. Overnight on board your Nile Cruise

itinerary.title: Visit Edfu Temple & East Bank of Luxor
itinerary.description: Enjoy your breakfast on-board. Try a new adventure by a horse-drawn carriage to visit the Edfu Temple of God Horus. Then return to the Nile Cruise, and continue sailing to Luxor via Esna lock. Once the cruise arrives in Luxor, visit Luxor Temple and Karnak complex on the east bank of Luxor. After that, you will go back to your cruise. Enjoy your dinner on-board. In the evening, enjoy the Galabia Party on the cruise. Overnight on board your Nile Cruise

itinerary.title: West Bank Tour / Luxor to Cairo
itinerary.description: Enjoy your breakfast on board before disembarking at 08:00 AM; today we will say goodbye to the Nile Cruise, as today is your final departure day from your cruise. Our Egyptology tour guide will join you to visit Hatshepsut temple, Colossi of Memnon & Valley of the Kings. Finally, today is your train back to Cairo, Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Luxor train station for departure back to Cairo by night Sleeper train. Then have dinner. Overnight on Sleeper Train

itinerary.title: Day at Leisure in Cairo
itinerary.description: Once you arrive Giza train station, you will be escorted by Ibis Egypt tours representative to your hotel, manage to relax, or try optional excursion to Alexandria city where you can taste different culture at Cata Comb of Kom El-Shokafa, Qaitbai Citadel, and Alexandria Library, walk through the magnificent Montazah Palace, or amuse your eyes by visiting Roman amphitheatre ( If visit was allowed ), other different optional at night are available between Dinner Cruise on the magic Nile River where you can enjoy watching real Belly Dancer and watching Folklore show. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Fly to Amman
itinerary.description: Enjoy your tasty breakfast at your hotel, then Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Cairo International Airport, catch your flight to Amman, once your flight landing at Amman airport, Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to your hotel. Overnight in Amman

itinerary.title: Madaba / Mt. Nebo / Dead Sea
itinerary.description: Morning time, we leave Amman toward Petra. Your first visit is to Madaba, where the St George's Greek Orthodox Church has a famous mosaic on the floor. Made during the 6th century AD, the mosaic shows the pilgrimage from the surrounding areas to the Holy Land. You can even find Egypt on this map! Your next visit recalls the story of Moses and his journey to the Promised Land. At Mount Nebo there is a Memorial for Musa (Moses) and a 4th century church which Italian Franciscan priests excavated and restored in 1933. The panoramic view overlooks the Jordan River Valley, the Dead Sea, Jericho and Jerusalem. In the Bible story, Moses does not ever arrive at the Promised Land, but he is able to see it from a distance before he dies. It is from Mount Nebo that one can see it in the distance (on a clear day). It is also believed that this is the burial place of Moses. Our last stop will be in the Dead Sea, the lowest point on earth, 417 m (1,373 ft.) below sea level and the largest "Natural Spa" in the world. The mineral-rich waters and mud flow with natural health and beauty benefits acclaimed globally. You’ll have time for your own. Float on the Dead Sea and make the experience not being able to sink in water. Try the beauty effect of the black mud on the shore. Evening, arrival in Petra and time to get situated in your hotel. Overnight in Petra.

itinerary.title: Petra Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy your tasty breakfast at your hotel, we will begin to explore the Red Rose City Petra. First established sometime around the 06th century BC by Nabataean Arabs, a nomadic tribe who settled in the area and laid the foundations of a commercial empire that extended into Syria. Despite successive attempts by the Seleucid king Antigonus, the Roman emperor Pompey and Herod the Great to bring Petra under the control of their respective empires, Petra remained largely in Nabataean hands until around 100AD, when the Romans took over. It was still inhabited during the Byzantine period, when the former Roman Empire moved its focus east to Constantinople, but declined in importance thereafter. The Crusaders constructed a fort there in the 12th century, but soon withdrew, leaving Petra to the local people until the early 19th century, when it was visited by the Swiss explorer Johann Ludwig Burckhardt. Upon arrival you will begin an unforgettable trip on horse back to the Siq and then by foot until you reach the Treasury. The local guide will give a brief history of the city. You will also see Pharaoh's Castle, the Triumphal Arch, the Amphitheater and Monastery. Late afternoon, we departure to Amman and assist with checking you into your hotel. Overnight in Amman

itinerary.title: Final Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy your tasty breakfast at your hotel, today we will say good bye to Jordan, it is your final departure day, after breakfast, Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Queen Alia Airport for final departure.
